title: brew bundle installs the HEY CLI instead of matching the stale hey-desktop cask
description: A leftover 'hey' desktop cask (renamed hey-desktop by Homebrew) answers to the bare token 'hey', so brew bundle says 'Using hey' and never installs basecamp/tap/hey. setup-hey then gives a wrong hint (--enable=packages).
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- Bootstrap removes the stale hey-desktop record before brew bundle (guarded on no HEY.app)
- setup-hey macOS hint gives a command that works
- command -v hey resolves after bootstrap
close_reason: clear-stale-hey-desktop removed the shadowing cask; brew bundle printed 'Installing hey', HEY agent skill installed

title: Stow skips .DS_Store so Finder litter can't abort the home tree
description: Finder dropped a gitignored .DS_Store in symlinked/home/; stow doesn't ignore it, collides with ~/.DS_Store, and aborts stowing the whole home tree.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- All stow calls in symlink-dotfiles pass --ignore for .DS_Store
- stow -n home reports no conflicts
close_reason: stow calls now pass --ignore='\.DS_Store' via STOW_IGNORES; dry-run with a planted .DS_Store shows no conflict (vs 1 without)

title: Brewfile declares firectl; heroku and graphite uninstalled
description: fw-ai/firectl, heroku/brew, withgraphite/tap own installed packages but aren't declared, so bootstrap warns every run. Kyle: keep firectl, remove heroku and graphite.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- Brewfile has tap fw-ai/firectl and brew fw-ai/firectl/firectl
- heroku and graphite uninstalled; next bootstrap prunes their taps
